Naye tainaat hone wale afsar ko yeh pata hona zaroori hai ke mojooda case load uttar punjab aur punjab ki kuchh tezamini shahr mein konsa ziyada tamaam ho raha hai. فیصل آباد (Faisalabad) mein 19, لاہور (Lahore) mein 18, راولپنڈی (Rawalpindi) mein 10, اسلام آباد (Islamabad) mein 5, چنیوٹ (Chiniot) mein 5, حیدر آباد (Hyderabad) mein 5, کراچی ایسٹ (Karachi East) mein 5, کراچی وسطی (Karachi Central) mein 5, aur ملتان (Multan) mein 1 case ziyada tamaam hai [Document 1].

Case mix ke muqayasay 2024 ke muqayasay 2026 mein kafi ziyada badlawa aaya hai. 2024 mein sab cases Pakistan Penal Code (PPC) aur Arms Ordinance 1965 ke talaq hai, lekin 2026 mein cases Control of Narcotic Substances Act 1997 (CNSA 1997), Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016 (PECA 2016), Punjab Domestic Violence Act, aur Illegal Dispossession Act 2005 jaise naye qanunon ke talaq bhi hai [Document 2].

73 FIRs mein se sirf 11 mein aaramt kia gaya hai, jabke 62 FIRs mein koi aaramt ki awham nahi hai [Document 3]. Aaj ke din, 2026 mein, ek zahm-e-gham ko report karnay ke liye 1401.3 minutes (23.4 ghantay) lagte hai, jabke 2024 mein yeh samay sirf 15.0 minutes tha [Document 4].

Aur 32 recovered weapons mein se 30 weapons ki license ki koi awham nahi hai [Document 5].

In sab sey naye tainaat afsar ko yeh pata hona zaroori hai ke mojooda case load ziyada tamaam aur tezamini shahr mein hai, aur kafi ziyada cases naye qanunon ke talaq hai. Aaramt ki awham sirf 11 FIRs mein hai, jabke aaj ke din zahm-e-gham ko report karnay ke liye ziyada samay lag raha hai. Aakhir mein, kafi ziyada cases mein recovered weapons ki license ki koi awham nahi hai.Response generated (1631 chars)

Naye tainaat hone wale afsar ke liye, yeh mukhtasar orientation note unhein mojooda case load se kya tawaqqo rakhna chahiye, is baare mein inform karta hai:

- **Districts with the highest case concentration**: فیصل آباد (Faisalabad) aur لاہور (Lahore) me sabse zayda cases hain, jahan 19 aur 18 cases kramashah karein hain [Document 1]. راولپنڈی (Rawalpindi), اسلام آباد (Islamabad), چنیوٹ (Chiniot), حیدر آباد (Hyderabad), کراچی ایسٹ (Karachi East), کراچی وسطی (Karachi Central) me 10 ya 5 cases hain, aur ملتان (Multan) me sirf 1 case hai.

- **Arrests recorded**: 73 FIRs me sirf 11 FIRs me aaramt kardar ka record hai, aur 62 FIRs me koi aaramt kardar ka record nahi hai [Document 3].

- **Reporting delays**: 2026 me, average time 1401.3 minutes (23.4 hours) hai, jahan 51 FIRs ke data se nikala gaya hai [Document 4]. 2024 me, 13 FIRs ke data se nikala average time sirf 15.0 minutes tha.

- **Weapon licensing**: 32 recovered weapons me se 30 weapons ka license record nahi hai [Document 5].

In sab information ke hisaab se, afsar ko tawabat aur aaramt kardar ke daam par kamaal ki zaroorat hai, aur FIRs ke report hone ke daam par bhi tawabat ke liye tayyar raho.
